sentences.en: In Kyoto, you can see both old and modern buildings.
sentences.zh: 在京都，你可以看到古老的建筑和现代的建筑。

sentences.en: The old proverb still holds good in our modern society.
sentences.zh: 这个古老的谚语在我们现代社会中依然适用。

sentences.en: The computer has made a great impact on modern life.
sentences.zh: 计算机对现代生活产生了巨大影响。
